roots.title: A sense of place
roots.description: Celebrating natural materials, local craftsmanship and the understated beauty of Khmer architecture.

spaces.title: Thoughtfully essential
spaces.description: Imagining a collection where space, light and the garden matter as much as the address.

care.title: Clarity comes first
care.description: Building an intuitive, multilingual and attentive journey, from discovering a property to following a project.

Preview.aboutTitle: A fresh perspective on the art of living.
Preview.aboutDescription: Envisioned in Siem Reap, KANTARA is a future platform bringing together properties, relationships and real estate services. This preview introduces its visual world; commercial services are still in development.
Preview.footerNotice: Visual prototype · no real commercial offers. Demonstration data only.

lotus.title: The Lotus Villa
lotus.description: An imagined residence arranged around a reflecting pool, with three garden-facing bedrooms and a shaded terrace. Khmer-inspired rooflines meet a natural material palette.

courtyard.title: The Courtyard House
courtyard.description: A fictional single-storey home arranged around a planted courtyard. Two bedrooms, generous openings and a terrace for the end of the day.

riverside.title: The Mekong Balconies
riverside.description: A demonstration apartment with clean lines, two bedrooms and a generous balcony. A contemporary interpretation of Khmer galleries and sun screens.

palm.title: The Palm Retreat
palm.description: An imagined villa in Kampot, surrounded by a tropical garden and open spaces. Three bedrooms, a covered terrace and a pool make up this fictional retreat.

terrace.title: The Quiet Terrace
terrace.description: A compact, light-filled fictional apartment with one bedroom and outdoor space. Warm tones and natural materials suggest a quieter everyday life.

garden.title: The Garden House
garden.description: A demonstration home designed for garden living: three bedrooms, an airy living room and a tree-filled courtyard, drawing on local architecture.
